automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Topic News Collector

cutoff_window.rule: Public sources must display an unambiguous publication or update date within the prior 48 hours. Date-only sources at the lower boundary are excluded.

federation.collector_boundary: Keep only local AI-assisted-development practice implications; do not create local entity coverage.

qualifying_updates.title: GitHub Actions workflow lockfiles in public preview
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub announced workflow dependency lockfiles that record reviewed action and reusable-workflow commits, require locked entries for onboarded workflows, support a stale-lockfile check, and can be required by enterprise, organization, or repository policy. Dependabot can update a workflow reference and its matching lockfile entry in one pull request.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Treat automation and agent-executed workflow dependencies as reviewable, immutable inputs: pin the action graph, run a stale-lockfile check in CI, review the dependency before locking it, and keep updates and their lockfile evidence in the same change. Locking limits moved-ref risk but is not a substitute for dependency review.
qualifying_updates.follow_up: Route to normal raw ingest if a maintainer wants a durable rule for agent-managed CI dependencies; retain broad GitHub product details upstream.
